title: IPv6: Dissect Segment Routing Header (SRH) optional TLVs
description:
Summary:

Implements dissection for IPv6 Segment Routing Header (SRH, Routing Type 4) optional TLVs as specified in RFC 8754.

Changes:

\- Dissect Pad1 TLV (Type 0) as a 1-octet padding TLV without length/data fields.

\- Dissect PadN TLV (Type 4) padding octets.

\- Dissect HMAC TLV (Type 5) including D flag, reserved bits, HMAC Key ID, and HMAC digest.

\- Parse TLV Type bit 0 indicating whether the TLV may change en route.

\- Register SRH TLV header fields and subtrees under ipv6.routing.srh.tlv.\*.

\- Add boundary checks and expert info for truncated TLVs or lengths exceeding the extension header.

commits_data.title: IPv6: Dissect Segment Routing Header (SRH) optional TLVs
commits_data.message:
IPv6: Dissect Segment Routing Header (SRH) optional TLVs

RFC 8754 defines optional Type-Length-Value (TLV) objects that carry metadata for segment processing in the Segment Routing Header (SRH).

Implement dissection of:

- Pad1 TLV (Type 0): 1-byte padding without length or value fields.

- PadN TLV (Type 4): multi-byte padding data.

- HMAC TLV (Type 5): D flag, reserved bits, HMAC Key ID, and HMAC digest.

- Generic / reserved TLVs: raw value bytes.

Also parse the TLV Type "may change en route" bit (bit 0) and validate TLV boundary lengths.
